blocks.html: The data to mark a payment collection as paid.

types.name: MarkPaymentCollectionAsPaidInput
types.description: The data to mark a payment collection as paid.

children.name: payment_collection_id
children.description: The ID of the payment collection to mark as paid.

children.name: order_id
children.description: The ID of the order that the payment collection belongs to.

children.name: captured_by
children.description: The ID of the user marking the payment collection as completed.

children.name: provider_id
children.description:
The ID of the payment provider to record the captured payment under.
Useful when the payment was collected through a specific provider
(for example a POS or cash provider) rather than the system default.

Defaults to the system (manual) payment provider when omitted, preserving
the previous behavior.
